strategies.name: FVG_Inversion_Scalp

strategies.exit_summary: Stop loss is placed above the high of the inversion candle. Target is either the drawn liquidity or a fixed 1:2 risk-to-reward ratio. Risk management involves moving to break even as soon as the closest liquidity after entry is taken out.
